verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. It documents programmatic API calls, an installable Python SDK and a server-side TypeScript/JavaScript SDK, OpenAI-compatible drop-in use, and a Batch API for asynchronous bulk workloads. Together these let it run unattended in automation pipelines without a UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI-specific guidance (e.g., CI secrets/env-var setup or a pipeline example), and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Cerebras REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously, making it perfect for workloads where you don't need immediate results
Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
